name: Dagger

specials.name: Forbidden Technique
specials.description: Inflicts you with Cursed Vengeance LV10 for 3 rounds. (Cursed Vengeance increases your damage by LV%, but drains your HP by LV% of your maximum HP every round.)

description: A simple dagger that anyone can use.

name: Lute

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Sub Type: Instrument

description: The lute is a musician's best friend. If you're a bard, don't leave home without it - you'll need an instrument to play your songs, after all.

name: Whip

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Sub Type: Whip

description: An incredibly simple yet effective weapon, the whip is less about lethality and more about threat.

name: Dagger (Enhanced)

specials.name: Enhanced Stats
specials.description: +3 GUI

specials.name: Forbidden Technique
specials.description: Inflicts you with Cursed Vengeance LV10 for 3 rounds. (Cursed Vengeance increases your damage by LV%, but drains your HP by LV% of your maximum HP every round.)

description: A simple dagger that anyone can use.

name: Stinger
description: A dagger with increased sharpness for extra stabbing.

name: Tanto

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Sub Type: Katana

description: A small blade with a sharp edge, the tanto is often used for personal protection or as a backup weapon when longer blades aren't available or are impractical.

name: Throwing Dagger

specials.name: Deadly Roundabout
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals 110% of Throwing Dagger's Scaled Weapon Attack over 10 hits of Pierce damage, which can critically hit.

description: A dagger made for long distance attacks.

name: Dagger of Bleeding

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (10%)

description: A dagger with a taste for blood.

name: Parrying Dagger

specials.name: Parry Bonus
specials.description: Increases activation rate of Parry skills by 15%.

description: A simple dagger that is made less for attacking and more for catching blades.

name: Shuriken

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Sub Type: Shuriken

description: A throwing-type dagger that originates from Oniga.

name: Bloodstained Flute

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (10%)

specials.name: Blood Coating
specials.description: Covers the flute in blood.

specials.name: Blood Song
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill), while the flute is covered in blood: Consumes the blood; All allies affected by the song recover HP equal to 5 + UL. All enemies affected by the song take protection-ignoring Dark damage equal to UL.

description: This bladed flute is stained with dark traces of red; the blood of the performer's enemies.

name: Creeping Darkness

specials.name: Fear Progression
specials.description: Inflict the target with Fear. If you have already Feared them, inflicts Hesitation LV 15 instead. If already Hesitating, inflicts Poison LV 5. All effects last 3 rounds.

specials.name: Light Reduction
specials.description: Reduces the duration of Glowing statuses you suffer from and any Light Shafts at your current location by 2 rounds.

specials.name: Spider Illusion
specials.description: Whenever one of your item effects reduces Glowing statuses or Light Shafts to 0 duration or less, creates a Spider Illusion at a nearby tile, which will approach enemies and deal 25 armor-ignoring Dark magic damage to them.

description: A whip adorned with a lash shaped like a spider. It devours light and makes shadows dance.

name: Nullifying Dirk

specials.name: Resistance Bonus
specials.description: +5 RES

specials.name: Dispel on Crit
specials.description: Dispells 1 Random buff from the target. (Can only trigger once every 2 rounds.)

specials.name: Arcanic Pierce
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the damage the attack deals by 15, and if it hits, spells you cast this round ignore 15% of elemental resistance.

description: A magical dagger, it seems, with the properties of erasure. It has the capability to restore things to their original state.

name: Thief Blade

specials.name: Steal Bonus
specials.description: Increases Steal's success rate by 15%.

specials.name: Pilfer
specials.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

description: A blade often used by thieves for its nimbleness.

name: Byakko Tessen

specials.name: Ice Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 25% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Water Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 25% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

description: A bladed, iron-fan often used by covert female assassins to kill targets from a close distance.

name: Seiryuu Tessen

specials.name: Lightning Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 25% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Wind Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Wind bonus damage equal to 25% of your Wind ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Dragon Dance
specials.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. While invoking, if you have a summoned Seiryuu that has at least 3M, 3M will be consumed by them and reduce the momentum cost you pay by 3M. After casting, you will gain Punishing Winds LV 60 for 5 rounds. Punishing Winds gives Seiryuu's Hunter Wind a bonus effect and deals Wind magic damage to all enemies at the start of a round equal to its LV.

description: A bladed, iron-fan often used by covert female assassins to kill targets from a close distance

name: Summoner's Tandem Dagger

specials.name: Summon Attack
specials.description: When you summon a Youkai with Summon Youkai, while an enemy is within 1 Range of you: you perform a basic attack on them with this weapon (which does 50% damage).

description: A dagger that aids in the summoning process. The dance of the blade calls youkai and carves enemies.

name: Suzaku Tessen

specials.name: Fire Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 25% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Wind Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Wind bonus damage equal to 25% of your Wind ATK, which ignores armor.

description: A bladed, iron-fan often used by covert female assassins to kill targets from a close distance.

name: Touyaa Shuriken

specials.name: Frostbite
specials.description: Status infliction based chance to inflict Frostbite LV20 for 3 turns.

specials.name: Snowflake
specials.description: Creates a 3 Range diamond of Ice Sheets at a target location within 3 Range, with a duration of 3 rounds.

description: A snowflake-styled shuriken that flies far.

name: Combat Magnifying Glass

specials.name: Drop Rate
specials.description: Increases rate enemies drop items by 25%.

specials.name: Culprit Declaration
specials.description: When an enemy defeats an ally, you inflict Hunted LV 30 on them for 5 rounds.

description: There's no telling when deduction will turn into a brawl, and so it's good to have implements with multiple uses. Like beating someone to death.
location: Purchased from Bandit in Meiaquar Sewers

name: Konosekai

specials.name: HP Bonus
specials.description: +15 HP

specials.name: Neverending Story Set
specials.description: 2+ - 1) +3 WIL. 2) +3 CEL. 3) +15% Sound Resistance.

description: A combat fan used in a certain famous singer's dance.

name: Magical Photon

specials.name: Spelledge
specials.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

description: Suitable for casting technics and wearing fancy hats. Will not help you transform, however.

name: Sea Hunter Dagger

specials.name: Hunted
specials.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

description: This dagger was born from the sea, and as anyone who lives there knows, anything that lives in the sea is out to get everything else... that lives in the sea.

name: Tamaki Shuriken

specials.name: Poison
specials.description: Status infliction based on chance to inflict Poison LV 20 for 3 turns.

specials.name: Acid Flower
specials.description: Unleashes a barrage of acid shurikens in all directions around you. If these hit an enemy, it performs a basic attack on them with a bonus to hit equal to Tamaki Shuriken's UL. Once it reaches its maximum distance or hits an enemy, it also creates a 2 range circle of Acid Pools and spawns a random flower at the location. These last for 5 rounds and have a LV equal to 1 + Tamaki Shuriken's UL.

description: A type of shuriken coated in venom.

name: Creed Replica

specials.name: Divine Weapon
specials.description: +2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.

description: A replica of a deadly assassin's dagger. It possesses extremely high power.

name: Crelia

specials.name: Ice ATK Substitute
specials.description: Replaces your Ice ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Warmth
specials.description: Requires Substitute Ice ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon, deals 20 armor-ignoring Ice Kickback damage to you, curing Frostbite effects you suffer from, and creating a wave of warmth that spreads out in a 3 Size Circle around you. In that circle, ice statues, ice sheets, frozen plants, and Frozen & Frostbitten allies thaw out. All allies also recover HP equal to 100% of the Substituted Ice ATK.

description: A dagger made with a flowery, but sharp, design.

name: Hikage

specials.name: Sun/Moon Set
specials.description: Damage type changes to Fire if Tsukikage is also equipped. Set: Hayabusa. 2+ - 1) +2 Attack Range with Daggers. 2) Movement type becomes Teleport. If Main Weapon is Tsukikage: Moon Style. Critical hits generate Moon Crests (max 3) and grants Moon Reflection skill. If Main Weapon is Hikage: Sun Style. Critical hits generate Sun Crests (max 3) and grants Rising Sun skill.

specials.name: Lingering Damage
specials.description: Inflict Lingering Damage (Fire) LV 15 for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Rising Sun
specials.description: Rising Sun: 2M, 15 FP, 2 Round CD. Consumes 3 Sun Crests. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range. Reappear at target location, when you do, become Airborne and deal 30 armor-ignoring Fire bonus damage to all enemies in 2 Range Circle. All damaged enemies are inflicted with Glowing LV 10 until your next turn.

specials.name: Muddle
specials.description: Item properties that would change the damage type of your basic attacks are ignored.

description: A ninja dagger with a red cloth tail, decorated with a moon.

name: Paragi Shuriken

specials.name: Knocked Down
specials.description: Status infliction based chance to inflict Knocked Down LV2 for 2 turns.

specials.name: Rairashi
specials.description: Launches sparks of lightning at a target enemy within 8 Range, dealing Lightning magic damage that ignores protection equal to 10 + Paragi Shuriken's UL * 3.

description: A heavy shuriken that is effective at knocking someone on their butt.

name: Puppet Strings

specials.name: String Attached
specials.description: Apply or power up String Attached (LV 1, max 4, 3 rounds). Only 1 string can attached per action (even if you have multiple Puppet Strings equipped, or attack with it multiple times). String Attached: The causer has attached a string to you. LV decreases by 1 every time you use a movement skill and end outside of 3 Range from them.

specials.name: Puppet Assault
specials.description: Targets 2 tiles in 6 Range. Location 1 must contain an enemy with String Attached LV 2+ (caused by you), and Location 2 must contain a different enemy. You puppeteer the first enemy, who takes 3 steps towards the second. Then, the first enemy is forced to attack the second with their main hand weapon (75% damage, or 100% if String Attached was LV4+). Afterwards, your strings detach from the first target.

description: Puppet Assault Gloves holding within them long puppet strings. One never knows when they may be forced to dance upon them.

name: Tsukikage

specials.name: Sun/Moon Set
specials.description: Damage type changes to Water if Hikage is also equipped. Set: Hayabusa. 2+ - 1) +2 Attack Range with Daggers. 2) Movement type becomes Teleport. If Main Weapon is Tsukikage: Moon Style. Critical hits generate Moon Crests (max 3) and grants Moon Reflection skill. If Main Weapon is Hikage: Sun Style. Critical hits generate Sun Crests (max 3) and grants Rising Sun skill.

specials.name: Spelldaze
specials.description: Inflict Spelldaze for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Moon Reflection
specials.description: Rising Sun: 2M, 15FP, 2 Round Cooldown. Consumes 3 Moon Crests. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range. Appear at location, gain Sneak until next turn and Night Shade (LV15, 2 attacks, 3 rounds).

specials.name: Muddle
specials.description: Item properties that would change the damage type of your basic attacks are ignored.

description: A ninja dagger with a blue cloth tail, decorated with a moon.

name: Bakaga Shuriken

specials.name: Smoke Screen
specials.description: Creates a Smoke Screen at the target's location for 3 rounds, reducing the Hit of those who stand in it by 30.

specials.name: Dark Hole
specials.description: Launches a swirling dark energy in a line that will travel up to 5 Range away. If it contacts an enemy, it will deal armor-ignoring Dark magic damage to them equal to 10 + (Bakaga Shuriken's UL*2) and begin moving back towards you, pulling the enemy along with it.

description: A shuriken with a smoke bomb hidden inside of it.

name: Copper Coliche

specials.name: Dual Weapon Type
specials.description: Also qualifies as a Sword weapon.

description: A small yet thin blade made of a reddish metal. It's somewhere between dagger and sword, making it a versatile blade.

name: Ninshi Shuriken

specials.name: Fire Damage
specials.description: Inflicts 30 armor-ignoring Fire damage to all enemies in 2 Range.

specials.name: Ignition
specials.description: Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and creates a single Cinder tile with a LV equal to (Ninshi Shuriken's UL * 2) for 5 rounds. If there is an enemy at that location, they also take armor-ignoring Fire damage equal to half of that. If there is a Bomb at that location, it will blow immediately as if you had a set it.

description: Shurikens designed to explode on impact.

name: Red Letter

specials.name: Fire Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Fire Exhaurire
specials.description: Triggers after the attack hits an enemy. Deals 25 Fire bonus magic damage that ignores armor to the target, and you gain Absorb Fire (Limited) LV 1 for 5 rounds.

description: A flame dagger used in ritual sacrifices by an old tribal cult inhabiting the lands near the volcano 'Autumn'. Mysteriously, the tribal cult was burned to the ground, and this dagger found its way elsewhere somehow. It is theorized that the volcano itself set fire to the forest that the cult lived in, however it is just a theory. In reality, they were all killed by a youkai.

name: Atlaua's Abaniko

specials.name: Silence on Crit
specials.description: UL% chance of inflicting Silence for 2 Rounds.

specials.name: Luckiness Dance
specials.description: Begins a rhythmic foreign dance which boosts the SKI and LUC of all party members in the current battle by Atlaua's Abaniko's UL/2 (min. 1) for 3 rounds.

description: A famous water dancer's dancing fan, this Abaniko carries with it a strange energy, filling those who watch its dances with joy.

name: Dancing Shiv

specials.name: Skill Cost Reduction
specials.description: Reduces cost of Dagger Skills by UL%.

specials.name: Fray
specials.description: If you are behind your target, inflict Fray LV 1+(UL/3) for 3 rounds.

description: While little more than a very well made dagger, the Dancing Shiv earns its name for the way its movements almost seem to be a deadly dance, making it far easier to utilize than most daggers.

name: Eternal Solitude

specials.name: Summon Damage
specials.description: When an enemy effect or skill summons an allied unit: the summoner takes UL protection-ignoring Akashic magic damage.

description: This thin dagger severs the line between allies.

name: Fangfare

specials.name: Evade Teleport
specials.description: If the tile behind your opponent is a valid battle tile, UL% chance that you teleport behind them, leaving behind an ice statue that shares your appearance. Also inflicts Immobilize on the attacker until their next turn if successful.

description: An icy fang-shaped dagger, no doubt belonging to some devious ice beast at one point.

name: Hexfang

specials.name: Curse Infliction
specials.description: Inflict Noshka's Famine, or Crippling Muysig, or Frailty of Credwa LV 3 for 2 rounds (Activation Rate: UL%). Prevents you from receiving Curse statuses by dealing damage to enemies.

description: A cursed fang with words of evil written on it.

name: Vorpal Fang

specials.name: Vorpal Strike
specials.description: +10 Critical, +5% Critical Damage. When critically hitting monsters with this weapon (excluding bosses, and monsters whose level is 10 or more higher than yours): 5% chance for the attack to do a Vorpal Strike, dealing 9999 Akashic damage. Critical hits from behind the target when attacking with this weapon have an UL% chance higher of becoming Vorpal Strikes (applies as a percentage to the base chance, not added to it.)

description: Some weapons are enchanted to become vorpal. Other weapons are born vorpal, molded by it. The Vorpal Fang is a unique dagger in that sense, taking the powers of the Vorpal Rabbit for itself.
